mapper.select: SELECT doc.name AS doctorName, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS consultCount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS prescriptionCount FROM doctor doc LEFT JOIN appointment a ON doc.id = a.doctor_id AND a.deleted=0 AND DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} LEFT JOIN prescription p ON doc.id = p.doctor_id AND p.deleted=0 AND DATE(p.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE doc.deleted=0 GROUP BY doc.id,doc.name
